entries.title: Synara v1.5.2
entries.note: Synara 1.5.2 Stable Linux ARM64: Download the ARM64 AppImage alongside x86_64. Each architecture has its own update feed. Usage analytics: Explore token and activity trends by provider, model and project. Costs are reported or estimated at API rates, not subscription charges. On macOS, This Mac can include local Codex and Claude Code sessions. Connected computers: Choose which computer's host-owned settings to edit and see available signed-in identity for supported Codex and Claude accounts. Reliability: Account recovery, chat sends, queued work and Remote connections handle interruptions more reliably. macOS update preparation and shutdown, simulator control, onboarding and rate-limit messages also improve. Installers and verification The exact-tag workflow passed quality gates, all three server test shards, all five native packages, macOS signing and notarization, Windows Defender, pro

entries.title: Synara Remote v1.0.6-remote.44 (legacy)
entries.note: Synara Remote is now part of Stable For new installations, download Synara Stable 1.5.0 . Install Stable separately, then sign in with the same Synara account to access your account data and paired computers. Local-only conversations remain in the app where they were created. This early-access release is kept for existing Synara Remote installations and their update feed. Fixed Pending MCP connector approvals stay pinned above the composer while you scroll, even when Worked for is collapsed. After approval or dismissal, the card stays in the transcript. Desktop downloads macOS Apple Silicon. Signed and notarized. Windows x64. Unsigned for this release. The published installer passed Microsoft Defender in CI and may show a SmartScreen prompt. Linux x64 AppImage. The exact release tag passed the full test suite and packaged startup checks on all three platforms.
